_comment: pov-process-reveal EDITING_STYLE — see SKILL.md §5. Counterpart to retention-hardcut, NOT a variant. Camera motion is the rhythm engine here; do NOT metronome-cut this footage. subtitleHighlightColor maps to ASS SecondaryColour (pre-spoken colour) — set equal to primary because one-word captions have no un-spoken state.

grade.note: mild by design — payoff is texture (frost, chrome, rust). Do not crush.

cutRhythm.note: median is an OUTCOME not a target. Cuts land on gestures completing. Automated fixed-interval cutting breaks this style.

audio.note: kill dead air by CUTTING, not by compressing. Reference has 15.1dB range and zero silence below -32dB.
